subject.title: [Bug]: OpenAI-compatible streaming tool calls are dropped when provider omits finish_reason

question: Should OpenClaw treat native streamed `delta.tool_calls` plus a clean SSE `[DONE]` terminator as sufficient provider intent for tool execution when `finish_reason` is absent?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the accepted fix controls a provider-safety boundary between valid no-finish tool calls and ambiguous truncated streams.

options.title: Accept clean-stream promotion
options.body: Land the linked fix shape that promotes native tool calls only after a clean `[DONE]` terminal and keeps EOF without `[DONE]` fail-closed.

options.title: Keep finish_reason required
options.body: Treat providers that omit a tool-use finish reason as incompatible until they emit an explicit finish signal.

options.title: Require provider opt-in
options.body: Add a provider capability or setting before allowing no-finish streamed tool-call promotion.

recommendation.title: Accept clean-stream promotion
recommendation.body: Land the linked fix shape that promotes native tool calls only after a clean `[DONE]` terminal and keeps EOF without `[DONE]` fail-closed.
